description: Two-channel bridge between the patch and an audio device, sending two signals out to it and bringing two back

params.text: Scales the signal sent to the audio device, from silence at one end of its travel to +12dB at the other, with unity gain in the middle

inputs.text: Sent to the first output channel of the audio device, 10V being full scale; with RIGHT unpatched this signal is sent to both channels
Sent to the second output channel of the audio device, 10V being full scale

outputs.text: Carries the first input channel of the audio device, full scale arriving as 10V
Carries the second input channel of the audio device, full scale arriving as 10V

notes: no sound passes until an audio device is chosen; a new one comes up on the first driver in the list with no device at all
the driver, device, sample rate and block size are picked by left-clicking the four lines of the display, each of which opens a menu of its own; none of them is on the panel's right-click menu
a larger block size makes dropouts less likely and adds latency of that many samples
menu: Master audio module — makes this module drive the engine's timing, so the patch runs at the rate of its device
DC blocker — strips any constant offset from the signals sent to the device, and starts set on this module
